# `ᵘ` — Unary

Monadic operator. Keys: `Alt-6 u`. Hanzi: `单` (`單`)

`fᵘ` calls `f` with its right argument alone. Any left argument is ignored.

| Call | Definition |
|---|---|
| `fᵘ Y` | `f Y` |
| `X fᵘ Y` | `f Y` |

```bpl
10-ᵘ3                   ⍝ ¯3
```

`fᵘ` is the two-function [atop](../composition.qmd#trains) `f⊢`. The superscript needs no parentheses when used as another operator's operand: `+/ᵘ⌸` sums each [Key](quad-equal.qmd) group, ignoring its key, as `(+/⊢)⌸` does.
